tei:div.tei:p: 1)༄༅/ oṃ swa sti/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma kun bzang bde skyong dbang mo'i zab gter chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs thig gi glegs bam gsum pa/ ma )rtags can 'dir/ thog mar phur pa'i skor la/ gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal ster ldeb/ phur sgrub bdud las rnam rgyal mtsho rgyal thugs bcud ldeb/ rtsa sgrub bar chad kun sel dngos grub bum bzang ldeb/ tshe phur zung 'brel du lde kha bsgyur ba ldeb/ rgyun khyer tshe phur 'don 'grigs gab byang ldeb/ tshogs mchod rgyun khyer tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dang*/ bsdu ldang bsngo smon bkra shis bcas ldeb/ tshogs mchod ye shes sprin phung ldeb/ bskang ba shel gyi me long ldeb/ tshogs mchod bsdus pa bsod nams chu gter ldeb/ me tshogs dngos grub lcags kyu ldeb/ drag bskul ye shes me phreng ldeb/ drag sgrub zab mo ldeb/ drag sgrub kyi cha lag sngon 'gro ldeb/ drag zlog spu 2) gri'i 'khor lo ldeb/ gtor zor gdab pa ldeb/ rtsa dbang dngos grub snye ma ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ mkha' 'gro'i skor la brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs mchog ster ldeb/ ḍā ki'i thugs kyi sgrub pa dngos grub bum bzang dang*/ skabs su mchod pa'i las rim/ gab pa bzhi ldan bcas ldeb/ mkha' 'gro'i don dbang dngos grub sgo 'byed byin rlabs bcud ster ldeb/ tshe sgrub yang bcud snying po ldeb/ me mchod dngos grub bang mdzod ldeb/ mkha' 'gro dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub thabs rgyun khyer yang zab snying po ldeb/ mkha' 'gro gsang ba 'dus pa'i don dbang skal ldan rjes 'dzin zab rgya can ldeb/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lo rgyus me tog chun po mdzes pa'i phreng ba ldeb/ ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bde chen mchog stsol ldeb/ ḍā ki'i tshogs mchod bdud rtsi'i sprin phung ldeb/ mtsho rgyal sgrub thabs rlung sems dbang sdud 3)bde drod rang 'bar ldeb/

tshogs mchod spros med rgyun khyer tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs dang*/ dngos grub lhag skyong smon lam/ me mchod bsdus pa tshogs gnyis myur rdzogs bcas ldeb/ rdzogs chen gnad kyi me long ldeb/ mtsho rgyal gsang dbang spros med don gyi snying po shes rab rtsa 'byed dang*/ 'pho ba ye shes sgo 'byed/ phag mo'i yan lag bdun pa/ sprul sku dri med kyi brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs/ yang klong chen rab 'byams sogs/ dbang mdzad lha mo'i rgyun bzlas bcas ldeb/ gsang dbang shes rab rtsa 'byed kyi ngo sprod gab pa mngon phyungs gsang ba'i srog thig mkha' 'gro'i gsang tshig ldeb/ mkha' 'gro'i gsol 'debs byin rlabs dpal phreng ldeb/ ḍā ki mtsho rgyal thugs sgrub dngos grub snye ma ldeb/ rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i spyi bskang nyams chag rang grol dngos grub char 'bebs ldeb/ mkha' 'gro'i 4) srog sgrub yang bcud snying po bskyed rim zur gsal rdo rje'i rgya can ldeb/ dgongs 'dus gnad byang bsdus pa gsal ba'i sgo 'byed gser gyi lde mig gsang ba'i rgya can ldeb/ mkha' 'gro'i srog sgrub yang bcud snying po dang*/ rgyun khyer tshogs mchod bsdus pa bcas ldeb/ nyams len gnad kyi man ngag ḍā ki'i thugs bcud ldeb/ dpal ri'i smon lam gsang lam mngon 'byed ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ rig byed ma'i skor la gsol 'debs byin rlabs dbyig thob ldeb/ sgrub thabs dngos grub mchog stsol dbang gi lcags kyu me tog phreng mdzes ldeb/ sgrub thabs bsdus pa dngos grub snye ma dang*/ rdzes rim mchod bstod bcas ldeb/ brgyud 'debs dngos grub char 'bebs dang*/ rang nyid skad cig dran rdzogs bcas ldeb/ mngon rtogs bsdus pa ldeb/ bla rdo srog gi 'khor lo yang gsang mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud rin chen snying po ldeb/ gsang 5)sgrub zab mo dang*/ gsang sgrub snang srid dbang sdud/

mchod bstod/ bskabs kyi dbang sdud dmigs bsal bcas ldeb/ sgrub thabs dang*/ mchod bstod/ 'dod gsol/ phrin bcol bcas ldeb/ las tshogs khams gsum dbang sdud phrin las myur 'grub ldeb/ lha mos rjes su 'dzin pa'i smon lam phan bde'i 'byung gnas dang*/ 'dod gsol smon lam bcas ldeb/ smin byed dbang gi 'jug ngogs dngos grub snye ma ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ gsang ba ye shes kyi skor la/ ma rgyud gsang ba ye shes kyi gsang sgrub rgyun khyer lam zab dngos grub snying po dang*/ bstod bskul byang bu bcas ldeb/ de'i mngon rtogs dang*/ mchod bstod zur byang bcas ldeb/ tshogs mchod ldeb/ sgrub thabs dbang gi rgyud smin ldeb/ bcas/ ༈ sgrub thabs gsol 'debs zhal gdams sogs sna tshogs kyi skor la/ 'jam dpal 6)mngon rtogs shes rab blo 'phel dang*/ de'i rjes rim mchod bstod/ tshogs mchod/ me mchod bcas ldeb/ dbyangs can lha mo'i bsgom bzlas bsdus pa ldeb/ tshe 'phel yid bzhin 'khor lo'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa dang*/ de'i mchod bstod/ 'chi ba bslu thabs ku sa li'i man ngag rje btsun sgrol ma'i gsol 'debs dpag bsam snye ma/ 'phags ma'i gsol 'debs 'jigs pa kun skyob bcas ldeb/ 'phags ma'i mngon rtogs bsdus pa byin rlabs chu gter dang*/ yid bzhin 'khor lo'i rtsa sgrub rdo rje'i snying po/ de'i rjes rim mchod bstod/ 'chi ba bslu thabs ku sa li'i man ngag bcas ldeb/ o rgyan tshe dpag med pa'i sgrub thabs tshe bcud bsdus pa 'gyur med g.yung drung ldeb/ tshe sgrub rdo rje pha lam nyi zla kha sbyor shin tu gsang ba'i rgya can ldeb/ tshe sgrub bsdus pa ldeb/ sa ra ha'i mngon rtogs byin rlabs sprin phung dang*/ de'i mchod 7)bstod bcas ldeb/ bcas le tshan dgu bcu go gsum dang*/ glegs bam gyi dkar chag rang nyid ldeb/ bcas bsdoms ldeb grangs/ bzhugs/ ༈ mtshungs med ḍā ki bde skyong dbang mo yi// zab gter mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod chos sde'i gzhung*// rig 'dzin dbang mos spar du btab spel mthus// zab chos phrin las mi nub mthar rgyas shog
༈ grub brnyes rig 'dzin ḍā ki'i 'khor los sgyur// sngon med gdams zab mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod bdag /mkha' spyod dbang mo bde ba'i rdo rje yi// ring lugs phyogs mthar 'phel rgyas rtag khyab shog
